issues.description: getEntry() destructures from IContentstackGetEntry (which inherits live_preview from ICommonContentstackConfig via IContentstackPageConfig) but does not destructure or forward the live_preview field to createContentTypeQuery. A caller passing live_preview to getEntry() will have it silently dropped, meaning live preview won't work for the getEntry code path. The same gap exists in getSingletonEntry() at line 403.
issues.suggestedFix: Add live_preview to the destructuring in getEntry() and getSingletonEntry(), and pass it through to createContentTypeQuery/createContentTypeEntryQuery alongside the other commonConfig fields, mirroring the pattern already established in getSingleEntry().

issues.description: Uses lang: "en-us" as any to satisfy the ContentstackLocales enum type. While this is in a test file and the pattern is common, it introduces an untyped any without an explanatory comment, which conflicts with the TypeScript strict compliance criterion.
issues.suggestedFix: Import ContentstackLocales and use lang: ContentstackLocales.EN instead of lang: "en-us" as any, or add an inline comment explaining why the cast is necessary.

summary: The implementation correctly addresses all 6 acceptance criteria for AMSD-2041. The live_preview block uses preview_token (not management_token) with enable:true, no host field is added inside the live_preview block, ICommonContentstackConfig gains an optional live_preview field (inherited by ICreateQueryConfig and ICreateEntryConfig), setCommonConfig forwards live_preview to Stack.livePreviewQuery(), and Stack.setHost() prioritizes CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST over CONTENTSTACK_API_HOST. All prior review feedback defects are resolved. Tests at the correct path (src/services/__tests__/contentstack.spec.ts) cover all three required scenarios plus additional cases. 26 tests pass across 2 suites. The change is concise with no over-engineering or hand-rolled logic that existing helpers already provide. Two minor issues noted: getEntry() and getSingletonEntry() don't forward live_preview despite their interfaces supporting it, and the interface test file uses an untyped as any cast for lang.
